the alignment of the discotic liquid crystal is controlled by the element of SAM, which is a kind of self-organized molecular layer on a substrate.

a study of the effect of surface treatment of a substrate on the alignment of discotic liquid crystals.
the effect of the element of SAM on the alignment of the discotic liquid crystals.
the relationship between the alignment behavior of C8O BT and the chemical structure of SAM.
